description: A SIGN clause on a GROUP item that contains no signed numeric data description entry (kb/Work PB1319). COBOL-85 admitted the clause only on 'a numeric data description entry whose PICTURE contains the character S, or a group item containing at least one such numeric data description entry'; the 2023 text of 13.18.52.3 SR1 admits any alphanumeric, national or strongly-typed group item. THE EDGE IS DERIVED, NOT QUOTED (the repo holds no 1985, 2002 or 2014 text, ratified decision #1): the 1985 wording is the vendor transcriptions of ANSI X3.23-1985 (Micro Focus, Veryant isCOBOL, Fujitsu, IBM Enterprise COBOL); Annex E lists no SIGN change, so 2014 = 2023; 2002 is the edition that recast SR1 around group categories with national group items (VCR row 7.40). GnuCOBOL 3.2 has no per-dialect arm here (silence, not evidence). Gated in ONE place, CheckSignClausesPass.
display: a SIGN clause on a group item with no signed numeric subordinate
citation: ISO §2023:13.18.52.3 SR1 (2023 text); ANSI X3.23-1985 SIGN clause syntax rule (vendor transcriptions); VCR row 7.40 (derived 2002 edge)
